name: code-formatter
description: Auto-formats code files right after the AI writes or edits them: unified layout (4-space indent, double quotes, semicolons, no width-based wrapping) for Vue/JS/TS/HTML/CSS/JSON/Markdown/YAML plus Java/PHP/SQL/Shell/TOML/Python/Go/C/C++; syncs prettier.* settings from VS Code/Cursor/Trae and respects the project's own .prettierrc
